name: How to use this
about: Two ways in: learn from zero, or add a language you don't know yet.

name: Computing foundations
about: Bits, how a CPU runs a program, the terminal, compilers and Big-O, before any one language.

name: CS foundations
about: From transistors to instructions, data structures, and the tools a working engineer uses.

name: Python
about: First script to CPython's objects, bytecode, free threading and async.

name: JavaScript
about: Values and functions to the engine, the event loop and the browser.

name: TypeScript
about: Types as a language of their own: structural typing, generics, and how the checker thinks.

name: Go
about: Small syntax over a scheduler and a garbage collector you will take apart.

name: Rust
about: Ownership and borrowing until the compiler feels like a colleague.

name: C++
about: Memory you manage yourself, and the abstractions built on top of it.

name: Low-level memory, SIMD and lock-free code
about: Atomics, memory order, vector instructions and data structures with no locks.

name: The same problems in five languages
about: Memory, strings, hash tables, errors, concurrency and dispatch, side by side.

name: Languages calling each other
about: The C ABI, FFI between all five languages, and WebAssembly.

name: Build, package, test and observe
about: Lockfiles, build systems, fuzzing, sanitizers and profiling in every language.

name: Machine and operating system
about: Inside a CPU core, the memory hierarchy, processes and the kernel.

name: Networking and APIs
about: From a packet on a wire to HTTP, TLS and the APIs you design.

name: Data systems
about: How databases store, find and protect data.

name: Distributed systems
about: Many machines agreeing on one answer, and proving that they do.

name: Cloud and delivery
about: Containers, Kubernetes, and getting code out safely.

name: Reliability and security
about: Seeing what a system is doing, surviving incidents, keeping attackers out.

name: Math for ML
about: The linear algebra, calculus, probability and optimisation models are made of.

name: Machine learning and deep learning
about: From fitting a line to training deep networks that work.

name: Reinforcement learning
about: Learning from reward: values, policies and modern methods.

name: LLM architecture, training and post-training
about: Tokens, attention, pretraining, and everything that happens after.

name: GPU computing and inference engineering
about: Kernels, memory, and serving a model fast to many people at once.

name: Applied AI systems
about: Retrieval, agents, and running models inside real products.

name: Safety, security and interpretability
about: What goes wrong with models, and how to look inside one.

name: Papers lab
about: Read a landmark paper with your editor open and build it as you go, 2017 to now.

name: Statechart Studio
about: Learn the web by building the tool that draws this site's pictures.

name: Capstones in your languages
about: Three systems built end to end in the languages you learned.

name: Capstones in AI systems
about: Train and serve a small LLM, run Raft, survive an incident drill.
